{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
sales = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Verify the premise: internal test orders have revenue = 999999.99
internal_test_count = sales[sales['revenue'] == '999999.99'].shape[0]
print(f"Number of rows with revenue = 999999.99: {internal_test_count}")

# Verify that completed orders have status = 'completed'
completed_count = sales[sales['status'] == 'completed'].shape[0]
print(f"Number of completed orders: {completed_count}")

# Convert revenue to float after removing commas
sales['revenue_float'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check if any row has revenue = 999999.99
has_internal_test = internal_test_count > 0

# If no internal test orders exist, then all completed orders are valid
if not has_internal_test:
    print("No internal test orders found. The constraint 'exclude internal test orders' does not remove any rows.")
    # Thus, total revenue from completed orders is just the sum over all completed orders
    total_revenue = sales[sales['status'] == 'completed']['revenue_float'].sum()
else:
    # Otherwise, exclude them
    completed_non_test = sales[(sales['status'] == 'completed') & (sales['revenue_float'] != 999999.99)]
    total_revenue = completed_non_test['revenue_float'].sum()

print(f"Total revenue from completed orders (excluding internal test orders): {total_revenue}")

total_revenue"}
